items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: They called her Lizzie. ... Yeah, Lizzie Miles. That's right. Well, she knew my brother well, too.

ctx.x: No, I was up in Missouri, taking care of my mother. Oh, yes. And she broke her hip during those two years. Uh-huh. So, I didn't—I never did even get to see that. I've heard it. Yeah. Because Dick Allen has a—
I wish you had— They have the tape. I wish you had come around when Lizzie was— You know this girl that sang Creole in the French Quarter? She just died just recently.
